services.desc: For both the thrill-seekers and these hesitant, these signature ziplines represent a hands-free, worry-free, and fully-guided experience you won’t find anywhere else on the planet!Ages 7+ - Maximum Weight 275lbsDifficulty: Easy & thrilling!Time: Varies by location📍 Available at WildPlay in Jones Beach and Niagara

blurb: Guests can experience a 150ft bungy jump, a 140km/h Primal Swing, canyon ziplines, treetop adventure courses with multiple levels, and axe throwing. The park is set on the Nanaimo River and offers activities suitable for thrill-seekers, families, and groups. Several bundles combine multiple activities for longer experiences.

quotes.text: What an experience. Did the obstacle course in the trees. All 4 levels then bungee jumping. One of the best days I’ve had in a long time. Would highly recommend. Was nervous about jumping at first but the professionalism and experience of their staff helped put my mind at ease. Another check off the ol’ bucket list. Cannot wait to do again!

Staff were friendly and enthusiastic. Did the bungee jump and had a blast. I was there on my own and one of the ladies cheered me on from afar and it gave me the courage to take the plunge. Lads who set up my gear explained everything thoroughly and were extremely nice!
